sentence: This project studies how polynomial systems can be unfolded step by step into simpler structures using combinatorial methods.
This project studies the foundations of data science, including machine learning and the analysis of high-dimensional data.
This project studies how a marine heatwave changes the genes of reef-building corals and which corals survive it.
This project studies the composition and behavior of light absorbing compounds in atmospheric brown carbon using mass spectrometry.
This project finds and describes seaweeds that live deep in the ocean and studies their genomic adaptations to low light.
This project designs and evaluates a mechanism that moves many soft robots independently with one external magnetic field.
This project builds a computer cluster with graphics processing units to support research in artificial intelligence, hyperspectral imaging and optics.
This project builds a way to use deep neural networks to find the important features in huge amounts of simulation data.
This project studies when and how quantum computing can help with decisions made under uncertainty.
This project builds a facility for making quantum devices at the nanoscale that work with atoms and photons.
This project brings together researchers to build statistical methods for complex data that does not follow standard geometric rules.
This project builds a system that lets robots map a room in three dimensions and identify objects, even ones partly hidden.
This project studies how order and disorder among atoms affect the behavior of hexagonal oxides, using precise growth and microscopy methods.
This project studies turbulence in a magnetized plasma in a Z-pinch experiment and compares predictions about heat and particle transport with measurements.
This project builds a tool using artificial intelligence that guides users to emulate attack scenarios and collects the resulting attack data.
This project studies how storms and other short events change which strains of the cyanobacterium Microcystis dominate in lakes.
This project builds a machine learning tool that studies bacterial whole genome sequencing data to predict antibiotic resistance.
